newsitem.title: USA: United Wisconsin Q4 net up despite charge.
newsitem.headline: United Wisconsin Q4 net up despite charge.

text.p: United Wisconsin Services Inc on Tuesday said its fourth-quarter earnings increased in spite of a one-time charge of $2.6 million, or $0.19 a share.
The company said net income rose to $2.4 million, or $0.18 a share, from $1.6 million, or $0.13, in the year-earlier period. Revenues increased to $323.5 million from $274.1 million.

United Wisconsin, a managed-care services provider, said the charge was related to the accelerated recognition of losses on two discontinued blocks of business and transaction expenses linked to its purchase of American Medical Security Group Inc in December.
Its shares were up 1-1/8 at 24-1/8 in late trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
